name: Pong
description: Pong against the CPU over nine levels, or two players: encoder and pads as paddles, the pads light the court, square-wave effects; the one app of the pong firmware kit
changelog: 0.1.0: Pong as a CrossPad app: 1 player against a CPU over nine levels or 2 players, encoder and pads, pad LEDs as the court, sound effects through the audio module, pause menu with Quit back to the other firmware slot
